Converts a bincode blob to YAML using a type lookup and reflection decode.

# Purpose
`fd_bincode2yaml` is a small command-line utility that converts a bincode-encoded blob into YAML text. It parses `--type` and `--file` arguments, loads the input file into memory, and uses the `fd_types_vt_by_name` lookup to select the correct type decoder. The program then computes the decode footprint, allocates the needed memory from a scratch workspace, decodes the binary data, and walks the decoded object with `fd_flamenco_yaml_walk` to write YAML to `stdout`. It also supports `--help` and uses workspace and scratch allocator setup to manage temporary memory during the conversion.
